artworks.title: The Second Naval Battle
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a naval scene with several ships engaged in a maritime confrontation. A large ship with billowing sails is firing its cannons, evident from the smoke rising from its decks. Other ships are also seen firing cannons, producing dense clouds of smoke. In the distance, more ships with sails and masts are visible against the horizon. The sky has textured clouds, and the composition is in monochrome, created with etching or engraving techniques to add depth and detail to the elements in the scene.

artworks.title: First Intermezzo
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical stage and performance. The artwork depicts an elaborate theater scene, showing an audience on both sides seated in ornate balconies watching a grand performance on stage. The stage design includes a large landscape backdrop with trees and hills, enhancing the illusion of depth. The performers appear to be engaged in a form of dance or ritual, organized in an expansive manner across the stage. The foreground and margins of the drawing are filled with detailed depictions of spectators, dressed in period attire, along with musicians and other attendants observing the spectacle. The drawing captures a sense of opulence and grandeur, likely illustrating an early Baroque or Renaissance-style court entertainment.

artworks.title: Second Intermezzo
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural ruins populated by strange figures. The ruins include arches, columns, and crumbling walls. Small figures are depicted engaging in various actions, possibly dancing or making dramatic gestures. Towers emit smoke or flames, adding a sense of movement. The overall atmosphere is chaotic and mysterious, blending architectural and supernatural elements.

artworks.title: Third Intermezzo
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is an image featuring an intricate architectural setting with columns, arches, and a large central courtyard filled with figures in different poses. Above, there are ethereal figures floating among clouds, possibly symbolizing a mythological or divine event. Rich drapery frames the top of the setting.

artworks.title: Storm off the Coast of Barcelona
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate etching of a maritime scene with multiple ships engaged in a naval confrontation. The composition includes various details such as the sea, ships, and figures, with a mythological creature present in the water. The style of the etching is detailed with fine lines, emphasizing textures and rendered in monochromatic tones of sepia-brown and ochre. The scene is filled with movement and tension as seafarers populate the boats.

artworks.title: Baptism of the Prince of Spain
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with multiple individuals mostly visible from the knees up. In the center, a bishop is standing behind a font, extending his arm forward as if to sprinkle water on a small child held by another man. The bishop wears a mitre and a long robe. The child is unclothed and extended towards the font, held by a man. Other individuals in the scene wear period-specific clothing, including prominent collars and layered garments. Various headgear is worn, including distinct veiled hats by some women. The group is surrounded by large columns and curtain-like drapery, creating a formal ambiance. Some attendees carry staffs.

artworks.title: Marriage of Margaret of Austria and Philip III
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a religious ceremony taking place in a grand architectural setting. The scene includes an altar surrounded by figures in elaborate clothing within a hall featuring arches and columns. The figures are engaged in various activities, including kneeling and gesturing. The drawing emphasizes the details of the clothing and architecture, giving a sense of formality to the scene.

artworks.title: The Envoy of Tuscany Thanking the Queen
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal meeting scene. The drawing shows a figure seated on a throne-like chair, facing another standing figure who is gesturing with one hand. The seated figure is on a slightly raised platform, wearing a robe with an elaborate collar. The standing figure also has a distinctively styled collar and holds a document in one hand. Surrounding them are additional figures standing in a semi-circle, observing the interaction. The onlookers are dressed in period attire with various collars, creating a historical or judicial setting. The use of line and hatching in the drawing adds depth and texture.

artworks.title: Entry into Ferrara
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horsemen and footmen in a procession. The image shows several figures on horses moving through an arched pathway with tall walls on both sides. The figures on horseback wear long garments and wide-brimmed hats, while other attendants walk alongside holding staffs or pikes. The composition is dense with figures and horses, creating a sense of movement. The drawing is detailed with fine linework and cross-hatching, emphasizing depth and texture.

artworks.title: A Capucin Bringing Thanks of the King of Bavaria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of individuals in historical attire in an architectural setting. The scene includes a grand hall or room with an arched opening and ornate detailing above the doors. Several figures are present, with a focus on two individuals in the foreground in elaborate clothing, appearing to be in conversation. To the right, a robed figure gestures, seemingly presenting or addressing the individuals. Behind them, more figures are visible, standing or walking. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth, typical of detailed engraving or etching work.

artworks.title: Death of the Queen
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a room scene with multiple figures present. Several individuals are depicted around a canopied bed, with the central figure lying in it. The individuals wear robes that may indicate religious attire, and some hold objects such as a cross or a bowl. The central figure in the bed has visible facial features and a beard, while others have indistinct features due to shading. The room is furnished with detailed, ornate elements, and the background features clouds with cherubs and other figures, creating a spiritual atmosphere. The shading and lines in the drawing give depth and texture.

artworks.title: Reception of the Envoy of Poland
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a historical scene indoors with a group of people. Most figures are shown in full-length view. The central figure is a seated woman on an elevated throne, turned slightly to the left. She has an intricately styled hairdo and ornate clothing, including detailed jewelry. Surrounding her are multiple individuals, predominantly men, wearing period clothing. There is a male figure kneeling in front of the seated woman. Behind and beside her, a row of women stand dressed in similar attire. The background features an interior setting with textured walls, possibly lined with panels or drapery, creating a formal atmosphere.

artworks.title: King and Queen in Consultation about the Turks
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a royal audience scene. The figure on a throne is accompanied by others, engaging with a figure approaching from the right. The setting includes an interior with drapery and an exterior scene visible through an archway, showing soldiers with spears and a drum. The attire of the figures is formal, indicative of high status, with elaborate collars and garments. The scene suggests a ceremonial or official interaction within a historical or allegorical context.

artworks.title: Meeting of Margaret of Austria and Philip III
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal court scene featuring multiple figures in elaborate clothing. The setting is an indoor scene that depicts a gathering of figures dressed in what appears to be Renaissance attire. They are positioned around a central platform, with some standing on it and others around it. The figures are adorned in ornate clothing with detailed ruffles and jewelry. There is an intricate canopy overhead. The artist has employed a detailed linework technique to illustrate the folds in the garments and the facial expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Arrival at Valencia
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The illustration shows a procession of people walking towards the right side. The individuals have serious expressions, with men having short hair and women having elaborate hairstyles. They wear ornate clothing typical of a historical setting, featuring ruffled collars and rich patterns. A man in the foreground wears a wide-brimmed hat and a decorated cloak. Some individuals are leading a horse with decorative harness. In the background, there are tall buildings, arched entrances, turrets, and a ship on the left side.

artworks.title: Embarkation at Genoa
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image displays seven individuals in historic attire standing near the water. The central figure, facing left, extends their right hand forward. They are wearing an ornate gown with a ruff around their neck. Surrounding them are six other individuals, also in historical clothing. Some hold objects, with one holding a scroll. The background shows the sea with waves, boats, and a fortress-like structure in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Reception at Mantua
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaging in a greeting or exchange. The individuals are standing and facing each other, with some performing gestures typical of interaction. The individuals have distinct facial features and are dressed in traditional, historical clothing with accessories. The background suggests an outdoor setting with abstract lines indicating clouds and open space.

artworks.title: Papal Audience
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal audience in a historical context. The image shows a group of figures gathered in an interior setting. The figures are dressed in elaborate, period-specific attire. Most figures are standing, while one figure is kneeling. The setting includes architectural elements like an archway, and additional background details are present. The central composition focuses on interactions among the figures, indicating a hierarchical or ceremonious event.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Receiving the Homage of Cardinals and Prelates
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures standing in a line. The drawing depicts a group of elegantly dressed figures gathered together. The central figures wear elaborate robes and gowns, indicating a setting of significance or high status. The background showcases a textured wall or curtain. The presence of various garments and cloaks adds to the atmosphere of opulence and solemnity. The artist uses fine lines and hatching to convey depth and detail, while the absence of color emphasizes the contrast and texture within the drawing.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Margaret of Austria to Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered on and around steps in an interior setting. The central figures seem to be engaged in a conversation, with one figure slightly bending forward. Others around them are dressed in historical European fashion, with some wearing head coverings. A woman holds a child to the right of the central figures, and additional figures are nearby. The background features columns and arches, suggesting a formal space.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Being Carried in a Chaise
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: It is a drawing of a historical scene with people gathered around a seated figure. In the scene, several figures are depicted engaging with a central figure who is seated under a large, decorated umbrella or canopy. The figures standing around are dressed in robes, cloaks, and period costumes. There are pole weapons in the background. The style of the drawing reflects detailed line work and shading typical of engravings or illustrations from historical texts.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria on Horseback
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession. The image shows a group of figures on horseback dressed in ornate historical attire. The horses are detailed with elegant tack and ornaments. One of the riders is under a parasol, indicating importance. The illustration is dense with details of uniforms and equipment, giving a sense of movement and grandeur. Fine lines and cross-hatching techniques are used to create depth and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: Philip of Spain Before Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The engraving features multiple figures in historical attire. Most figures are shown from the waist up, with two men on each side shown in full. In the center, a kneeling man is depicted in profile, bowing slightly with one arm extended. He wears a cape and knee-length pants, with a ruffled collar. To the left, a woman stands elevated on a step, wearing an elaborately patterned gown and an intricate ruff. Her hair is styled elegantly. Across from her, several observers stand in a line, mostly women in similar long gowns with ruffled collars. The men also wear cloaks, doublets, and decorative collars, holding cylindrical objects. The scene is indoors, indicated by a paneled background suggestive of a grand hall.

artworks.title: Philip II of Spain on His Throne
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows five men in a room. The central figure on the left is seated in a chair, one leg crossed over the other. The seated individual has a thick beard and wears a hat, a high-collared cape, and a tunic with vertical stripes. The standing man in front of him holds a document or scroll and is dressed in similar period attire with a doublet, ruff, and short cape, carrying a sword at his side. Behind him, three other men are visible; one holds a scribe or documentation, while the other two look engaged in conversation. Their faces are detailed with period-specific hairstyles and ruffs, and they are dressed in high-collared cloaks and hose. The man closest to the viewer on the right holds a hat and a walking cane. The scene takes place in a room with draped curtains and a window letting in light, adding depth to the monochrome image.
